t: What your mortgage REALLY costs (one Excel formula) #shorts
d:
=PMT(B2/12,B3*12,-B1) gives the monthly payment (300,000 at 5% over 25 years = 1,753.77). Multiply by B3*12 for the total paid (526,131), subtract the loan for the interest (226,131).

Works in Google Sheets and Excel. Every formula was tested in a real spreadsheet.

t: Why your timesheet total is wrong (and the fix) #shorts
d:
Hours over 24 wrap around in the h:mm format. Use the custom format [h]:mm, then =B5*24*rate to bill decimal hours.

Works in Google Sheets and Excel. Every formula was tested in a real spreadsheet.
